title: Uncertainty and Fairness Awareness in LLM-Based Recommendation Systems
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured recommendation bias and disparity in movie and music recommendations based on the user's specified religion. It quantified the variability and unfairness in generated recommendation lists when prompts were conditioned with religious identity attributes.
findings: The study found that Gemini 1.5 Flash exhibits systematic and significant unfairness in recommendations based on religion. For the movie dataset, religion was the attribute with the highest measured disparity (SNSR and SNSV scores). For the music dataset, religion was also identified as one of the most disadvantaged attributes. These disparities persisted even when prompts included typographical errors or were translated into other languages.
